scope: Identification only. No application code changes or deployments.
incident_limit: The exact reported incident was not captured. Failure paths were verified through current-source inspection and controlled fault injection; ordinary live startup was also measured.

findings.finding: App bootstrap waits indefinitely on a stalled fetch or stream before React and its watchdog exist.
findings.evidence: Exact bootstrap function in VM: stalled 58% stream and unresolved fetch insert no module script.
findings.limitation: Can cause an indefinitely stuck App row; screenshot already passed this row.

findings.finding: Injected module script has no error handler, retry, or error state.
findings.limitation: A module load error can leave the static boot screen indefinitely.

findings.finding: Untimed base.json and polar index requests can keep providers returning wait, including the remote fallback.
findings.evidence: Actual provider function VM checks: one pending fetch, repeated wait from local and remote providers. Polar equivalent at 1045/1061.
findings.limitation: Permanent underlying imagery wait; outer startup screen may time out.

findings.finding: Height-map retries only run after rejection; stalled headers or body have no per-request timeout.
findings.evidence: Source inspection; live cold DEM transfers were very slow but completed.
findings.limitation: Mountains can wait to the 90-second outer limit; underlying terrain request remains pending.

findings.finding: A failed manifest resolves to an empty list and stays cached; a stalled manifest promise is also reused indefinitely.
findings.evidence: Actual function VM: healthy network replacement still returns empty list after initial failure, fetch count 1. MoonMap 573 awaits manifest outside its nominal 5-second warming budget.
findings.limitation: Reload can recover missing layers; stalled manifest can extend layer stage to 90-second limit.

findings.finding: Worker error permanently removes worker and leaves warm/value/control promises unresolved.
findings.evidence: Exact class test: three callback maps stay size 1; no promise settles after registered error; worker null.
findings.limitation: Layer startup delay up to outer timeout; existing value reads can remain pending indefinitely.

findings.finding: Calculator UI hooks have no timeout or worker error handler, and a loading cache entry suppresses repeated requests.
findings.evidence: Exact-source VM with nonresponding worker: cached loading retained, repeated spot sends no new request.
findings.limitation: Permanent calculator-card loading; separate from the screenshot photo stage.

findings.finding: App 180-second fallback sets only UI completion while map navigation remains disabled until actual preload completion.
findings.evidence: Replayable exact preload source with fake clock: completion 201058ms, done false at 180000ms. Navigation linkage in MoonMap 552/612.
findings.limitation: Enter can open a temporarily locked map, and continuing preload can move the camera.

findings.finding: Timeout helper treats rejection as success; layer supporting-file result is discarded.
findings.evidence: Replayable fake-clock test: rejected DEM reports Mountains done and launches science; supporting 404 reports Layers done.
findings.limitation: Successful-looking rows do not reliably mean usable assets.

findings.finding: Fraction derives from a changing queue and can move backward; event dedup also suppresses row-only changes.
findings.evidence: Live primary cold progress 14% to11%, and 86% to83%. Exact-source test retains displayed photo 58% while work advances to 60%; dedup at 172.
findings.limitation: Creates false impression of freezing; does not itself stop loading.

findings.finding: Stand here with 3D mountains disabled cannot park rover or satisfy required surface coverage; timeout is inside the impossible guard.
findings.evidence: Exact-method VM: valid level 18 camera ground, safe clearance, five coverage frames; readiness false at 4s and 1h. Terrain provider change MoonMap 689.
findings.limitation: Deterministic surface loading hang under this setting; not the initial screenshot. No live UI reproduction yet.

live_fallback.probe: capped at 60 seconds; incomplete, not an infinite-hang conclusion
live_fallback.observed_failure: Music request cylinder-five.m4a failed with net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR; music stage released at its 20-second timeout.
